claims.text: Across all 1,468,414 live declarations in solution.ndjson.zst / kernel.db (4 unused Challenge decls have live_mask=0), native_decide = 0, decide_cbv = 0, Lean.ofReduceBool = 0, Lean.ofReduceNat = 0, Lean.trustCompiler = 0, and sorryAx = 0; axioms are strictly [propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice], and flags!=0 consists solely of 129,020 F_REFL_TRUE (flags=1) and 472 F_REFL_TRUE|F_OF_DECIDE (flags=3).

Source scanning across 175,187 .lean files finds 34 files (124 comment-stripped lines, 151 occurrences) using decide +kernel, of which exactly 14 files (31 lines/occurrences, 18 live enclosing declarations, 35 F_REFL_TRUE ._proof_1_* auxiliaries) contribute live kernel terms (all live_mask=31); the other 20 files contribute 0 live decide_kernel declarations (13 DEAD_IN_LIVE_MODULE with 45 lines/52 occ, 7 ABSENT_DEAD with 48 lines/68 occ).

kernel.db taint_sources (class='decide_kernel') contains 36 rows across 16 modules due to two indexing quirks: it falsely attributes anonymous example lines in LoweredSignatureVanishing.lean:47 and TwSingle.lean:74 to signCard_dualPar and evenF, and omits GlobalTheory.LatticeInvariants.discr_of_cyclic (reach depth 14 from riemannHypothesis) plus Eisenstein4CoeffBound._proof_1_2 auxiliaries.

Of the 5 lean4lean fuel-timeout files, 4 (DyadicPrimeIntervals.Run1..4 at intervals 32768..131072) are 100% dead code (0 kernel decls, cut off at CylinderCountFamily.family_bound_all and JCount.family_count_all), while ChebyshevPrimeBounds/SmallLoop.lean (PI.PC.loop_run, 131,070-step sieve with wheel B=362, dist_RH=21) is 9/9 live (live_mask=31).

Every one of the 18 live decide +kernel declarations verifies a small, decidable finite check: rational Bernoulli B_4=-1/30 and B_6=1/42 (4 files), prime-factor/LCM/prime-reciprocal tables on finite N<=20000 or n<=131071 (5 files), cyclotomic BB_disj0 gcd/padicVal exclusion (1 file), primeFactors for n<=10 (1 file), 8-state Fin 3->ZMod 2 matrices (EpDimb), and 256-state 4x4 Boolean transitive closure SAT (RedList). None feed Pillar B (galoisLocalGlobalStrong_recParameter).
